theses.thesis: Semiconductors is the top-ranked theme, passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible), shows trend-consistent Hurst (0.51), and is not crowded. While cross-sectional momentum rank has no forecast edge, the trend-gate provides the only validated edge (drawdown avoidance), and the theme's leadership is persistent. The narrow breadth (0.182) and low absorption (0.37) suggest the move is concentrated and not yet collapsing.
